script_text: Stop! Cancer, the cosmos just flipped a switch in your chart. But listen closely: Mars is storming through your own sign, your 1st House of Self, squaring Saturn and dreamy Neptune in Aries. In love, Venus in your 4th House of Home sextiles lucky Jupiter in your 2nd — a cozy night in turns deeply bonding; single Crabs, someone warm appears through family circles. Financially, Jupiter in your 2nd House of Income backs a bold ask — pitch numbers, not feelings. Warning: with Mars squaring Neptune, read every contract twice. Follow for tomorrow's reading!
